business_summary: Mingxin New Material Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of automotive interior materials in China. It offers Verona microfiber, Menocra microfiber, Mingxin leather, and Hurongo PU materials used in automotive seats, armrests, headrests, steering wheels, dashboards, door panels, and headliners. The company was formerly known as Mingxin Automotive Leather Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mingxin New Material Co.,Ltd. in January 2016. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Jiaxing, China.
